about.headline: Decks are all we do, so we do them right.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a deck builder: a fair price before work starts, a deck delivered on time, and boards that are built to last in the Florida weather. Every job is planned around that, from a repair to a new build.

finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a free quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your deck.

faq.a: Yes. Send a few details and photos through the form or give us a call, and you'll get a price before any work starts.
Grandin, Ocala and the surrounding area. Tell us where the deck is when you get in touch and we'll confirm.

faq.q: Can my old deck be repaired?
faq.a: Often, yes. We'll look at the framing and boards and tell you honestly whether a repair, a restoration or a new deck makes more sense.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set a time to look at the job.
